name: Ridgeline Pour-Over Kettle
facts: Works on gas burners, electric coil stoves and camp stoves

name: Basecamp Hand Grinder
facts: Holds up to 30 g of whole beans
18 click settings, from espresso-fine to French-press-coarse

name: Ember Two-Burner Camp Stove
facts: Runs on propane only (standard 1 lb / 16.4 oz cylinders). Not for butane canisters
Can connect to a 20 lb propane tank with a standard adapter hose (not included)
Push-button piezo ignition, wind guards included

name: Trailhead Insulated Mug 12 oz
facts: Keeps drinks hot for up to 6 hours and cold for up to 12 hours
Mug body is dishwasher safe; wash the lid on the top rack

name: Summit Enamel Mug Set (4 x 10 oz)
facts: When bought at the clearance price ($24) the set is marked Final sale

name: Firefly Rechargeable Lantern
facts: Rechargeable via USB-C; a full charge takes about 3 hours

USB-A output to charge a phone in an emergency

name: Campfire Roast Whole Bean Coffee 12 oz
facts: Medium-dark roast with notes of chocolate and toasted nuts
Roasted every week; ships whole bean only
Returns accepted only if the bag is unopened
